definitions.explanation: The process of sending data, signals, or information from one point to another through a communication channel or medium.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝送|でんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}した→完了する：20676_kanryousuru⟧。
⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ファイバー⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{高速|こうそく}→高速：02749_kousoku⟧{伝送|でんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}している→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: High-speed transmission via fiber optics is becoming widespread.

examples.japanese: {伝送|でんそう}{速度|そくど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{途切|とぎ}れて→途切れる：18055_togireru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When the transmission speed is slow, video playback can get interrupted.

notes:
A technical term primarily used in telecommunications and information technology. Composed of {伝|でん} (transmit; convey) + {送|そう} (send). Focuses specifically on the movement of data or signals through a medium, as opposed to the broader concept of communication.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝送|でんそう}{速度|そくど}: transmission speed
- {伝送|でんそう}{路|ろ}: transmission path; channel
- {伝送|でんそう}⟦{方式|ほうしき}→方式：05454_houshiki⟧: transmission method
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧{伝送|でんそう}: data transmission
- ⟦{無線|むせん}→無線：09226_musen⟧{伝送|でんそう}: wireless transmission

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{送信|そうしん}→送信：17692_soushin⟧: sending; transmitting — the act of sending from the sender's side
- ⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧: communication; telecommunications — broader term covering both sending and receiving
- ⟦{転送|てんそう}→転送：14792_tensou⟧: forwarding; transfer — relaying data or messages to another destination
